recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the Senior Developer position, focus on gaining relevant technical skills, enhancing your CV structure, and providing measurable results for your projects.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Add Work Experience Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Including a work experience section can provide insight into any internships or relevant job roles, which is crucial for a senior position that requires extensive experience.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV currently lacks a work experience section, which is common for students but still a notable absence for a senior role.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have completed internships or relevant job roles, add a work experience section to your CV detailing your responsibilities and achievements.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will enhance your CV's completeness and demonstrate your practical experience in software development.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Include Measurable Outcomes for Projects
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Adding measurable outcomes for your projects can significantly strengthen your CV by showcasing the impact of your work.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV does not include measurable results or quantifiable achievements in project descriptions, which weakens its impact.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, add measurable outcomes such as performance improvements, user engagement metrics, or any other relevant statistics that demonstrate the success of your projects.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will improve the CV's effectiveness and provide concrete evidence of your skills and contributions.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Reorganize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: A well-organized skills section improves readability and allows recruiters to quickly identify your relevant skills.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The technical skills section is not well organized, making it harder to read and assess your qualifications.

recommended_actions.action_description: Reorganize your technical skills by grouping similar skills together (e.g., programming languages, frameworks, tools) to enhance clarity and readability.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will improve the CV's structure and make it easier for recruiters to identify your relevant skills.

missing_required_skills_recommendations.evidence: The job posting requires ASP.NET, which is not mentioned in the CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: Consider taking an online course or tutorial to learn ASP.NET, as it is a key requirement for the Senior Developer role.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will help you acquire a critical skill needed for the job and improve your job matching potential.

recommended_actions.action_description: Consider learning C# through online resources or courses, as it is essential for the Senior Developer position.

soft_skills_recommendations.title: Evidencing Soft Skills
soft_skills_recommendations.reason: Demonstrating soft skills through specific examples can strengthen your CV and align it with job requirements.
soft_skills_recommendations.evidence: While you have listed strong communication and teamwork skills, there are no specific examples provided in the CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: Include specific examples from your projects or university experiences that demonstrate your communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will provide concrete evidence of your soft skills and improve your overall CV quality.
